cache_hit_h2.what: the same document over HTTP/2, 16 connections x 10 streams

cache_hit_image.what: GET a ~200 KB cached image: copy and TLS cost, not request cost

cache_hit_small.what: GET a 5 KB cached JSON document, TLS, HTTP/1.1, 64 keep-alive connections

cache_hit_small_logs.what: cache_hit_small with the access log on in both: zion's default, nginx's combined format

download_10m.what: a 10 MiB body streamed through the proxy, 8 connections

latency_15k.what: a fixed 15000 req/s on the cached document, latency corrected for coordinated omission

latency_5k.what: a fixed 5000 req/s on the cached document, latency corrected for coordinated omission

proxy_nocache.what: no cache: every request goes to the origin (origin: no-store)

site_mix.what: the whole example site, Zipf-popular paths, hot cache

site_mix_logs.what: site_mix with the access log on in both

static_files.what: zion `static` mode and nginx `alias` serving the files from disk

tls_handshake.what: Connection: close, so every request is a new TLS handshake
